summary: Golub Capital Private Income Fund I, a non-listed BDC, filed a routine 8-K reporting an unregistered sale of 96,269 common shares at $24.30 NAV per share for $2,339,348 as of September 1, 2026, under Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation D and/or Regulation S, with no underwriting discounts or sales load. It also disclosed a $0.1667 per-share September distribution payable September 30, 2026, paid around October 30, 2026, plus portfolio commentary: 171 companies, $438 million fair value, 99% first-lien, 1.14x leverage, and $212 million NAV. No deal terms or special situation.
